# exo_hosted_content_filter_rule (Resource)

Manages the HostedContentFilterRule object via New-HostedContentFilterRule / Get-HostedContentFilterRule / Set-HostedContentFilterRule / Remove-HostedContentFilterRule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosted_content_filter_policy` (String) Maps to the -HostedContentFilterPolicy parameter.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
